text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm going to hold landing for PR #18999 until we confirm the cross-region DB migration window. CI is still in the queue and schema change might collide.
Oliver: Thanks — is the migration window confirmed yet?
Maya: Not yet. I asked infra to confirm timings with ops. If migration is at 22:00 UTC we should avoid merging anything touching user_profile.
Sami (infra): @Maya ops asked for a 30m buffer; they tentatively reserved 22:30-23:00 UTC for the migration. Waiting on final confirmation.
Oliver: Ok — can we rebase after the migration if needed? Concerned about the rebase window and the deploy freeze later tonight.
Maya: We can rebase but prefer to avoid it during freeze. Plan A: hold PR until post-migration. Plan B: quick rebase + linearize if ops gives go.
Priya: FYI CI flaky on macos-e2e for this branch — failing on an unrelated UI test. Might slow merge. :frowning:
infra-bot: Build 91827 queued on runner-group:linux-workers (position 4). Estimated start: ~8m.
Jordan: I can jump on the mac test if you want, Priya — can re-run after the mac patch.
Priya: Thanks Jordan — please re-run when linux completes, I pushed a tiny test fix.
Anika: Release lead here — remember there's a deploy freeze from 23:45-00:30 UTC. If migration spills into that window we need to postpone non-critical merges until tomorrow morning.
Maya: Noted. For clarity: holding PR now. Will post an update when ops confirms 22:30 slot.
Oliver: Can someone add the hold label to the PR and add a short note in the PR description about the migration dependency?
Maya: Done — added label "hold/migration" and comment: "Holding merge until cross-region DB migration confirmed (ops)."
Sami (infra): Ops confirmed 22:30-23:00 UTC. Migration touches user_profile indexes; recommend no schema-related merges until 23:15 UTC.
Anika: Given the freeze window, let's target safe-merge earliest 00:35 UTC and only if CI is green and no new schema PRs land.
Jordan: I'll keep an eye on CI and ping the thread if macos-e2e stabilizes. :eyes:
Maya: Thanks everyone. Will unhold in this thread once it's safe.
Oliver: Appreciated — I queued a rebase draft in case we need it after migration: ``git fetch && git rebase origin/main``
Priya: macos-e2e passed on rerun. infra-bot: Build 91827 succeeded.
Maya: All right — unholding now per ops and Anika if no objections.
Anika: Go ahead, but confirm CI green before merge and avoid pushing any schema PRs into the next hour.
Maya: CI green, merging after a quick final review. Thanks all.
